title: Podcast Visual Scan
description: The episode's visual scan. Joins the stock pose_estimation output (text lane, one JSON person list per sampled frame) with frame_grabber's frame table (table lane) and the episode reference from podcast_ingest (text lane): clusters the faces into the people on screen (screen positions with a thumbnail and a presence timeline), detects shot changes with ffmpeg's scene score, writes analysis/visual/people.json + scenes.json and records the scan in project.json. The manifest is returned on the answers lane.

podcast_visual.sample_seconds.title: Seconds between sampled frames — must match the frame grabber
